summary: An opencaselist wiki-to-docx conversion: the Verbatim styles are all defined and not one paragraph references them, so every unit comes from a heuristic. A disclosure records a card's first and last words with an ellipsis between, which makes the card ABBREVIATED, and sometimes records no body at all, which makes it CITE_ONLY. Neither is padded out and neither is dropped.
